items.claim: [r37-3] `stream()` stops the element's current stream before the new one is known to start
items.note: (no longer applies). Commit d62b0810b7 fixed it. `restream` in `packages/audio/src/streamStarter.ts:102-117` now launches the new stream first. It stops the earlier stream only if the new one is playing, so a stream that throws or drops leaves the earlier one sounding.

items.claim: [r37-10] a non-finite `insertFadeMs` / `fadeMs` throws out of `InsertChain.add` halfway through a splice
items.note: (no longer applies). Commit 3edbcb1252 fixed it. `createAudioEngine` checks `insertFadeMs` with `checkSpan` before it builds anything (`createAudioEngine.ts:212`). `createInsertChain` checks `fadeMs` on construction (`inserts.ts:87`) and `createAudioGraph` does the same (`graph/createAudioGraph.ts:30`). A bad fade now throws a `RangeError` before any route is wired, and never inside `add`.

items.claim: Synth voice's duration, envelope, filter, and glide numbers go unchecked, so the worklet mixes NaN into the bus
items.note: (strict call recorded in `docs/unruled.md`: a negative duration or glide time throws too)

items.claim: A partial's non-finite gain makes every partial NaN
An unknown wave name is looked up through the prototype chain and kills the worklet bus processor
An empty harmonic wave throws on nodes but plays silence in the worklet
An unknown filter `type` is a lowpass on nodes and an allpass in the kernel
The `PeriodicWave` cache has no bound
items.note: (LRU of 64, keyed by normalized levels); A's half about the kernel's noise-loop map, keyed by any color string, is fixed 68030d1f00 (unknown colors refused, so the map holds at most 3 colors × sample rates)

items.claim: A negative rate on a worklet noise voice reads before its loop and outputs NaN
`setRate(0)` or a negative rate on a node note throws a TypeError and keeps throwing on every `setDetune`
items.note: (strict call recorded in `docs/unruled.md`: a note's rate must be above 0, on both paths)

items.claim: A pattern event the engine refuses kills the player while `isPlaying()` stays true
items.note: the non-finite `step` that A also mentions is fixed 9be3e98b0c

items.claim: `inserts.settled()` never resolves after a dispose mid-crossfade
Non-finite `lookahead`, `tickInterval`, or `insertFadeMs` is taken unchecked
`setMood` with a NaN axis freezes the score on its last bar
A score bar entered after a stall plays the previous bar's events on its first booked step
items.note: on top of 861f240543, which adds a public `beforeStep` option to `createPatternPlayer` (minor changeset, `api new`)

items.claim: `createOscillatorNode` took unknown wave names, empty harmonic arrays, and partials unchecked
`createNoiseNode` took an unknown color unchecked
Synth patch numbers go unchecked at the call: NaN envelope, duration, glide, filter or partial gain, a negative duration, a partial decay of Infinity
Empty or NaN harmonic `wave`
Voice rate of 0 or below: a node note throws a TypeError, a worklet noise mixes NaN into its bus
items.note: This needed a behavior call nobody had made. My call is strict: a rate of 0 or below now throws `RangeError` on every voice kind, buffers and streams included, with no opt-in override. It is recorded in `docs/unruled.md`, and the changeset is tagged `fix behavior`.

items.claim: `stream()` stops the playing stream before the bus, lock and dispose checks
`StreamOptions.offset` is not checked
The media-element source cache is per engine, so a second engine on the same context cannot stream the element
items.note: Which voice holds an element moved to the context too.

items.claim: A NaN score mood throws a TypeError, and a running score freezes on its last bar
`lookahead`, `tickInterval` and `insertFadeMs` are not validated, and a NaN fade half-wires an insert chain
items.note: The same check is also added to `createScheduler`, `createInsertChain` and `createAudioGraph`.

items.claim: `stop(fadeMs)` on a releasing voice cuts it dead
One event that throws at its play call stops the pattern player for good
items.note: This also fixes `createScore`, which plays through a pattern player.

items.claim: `release()` on a fading voice tore it down and cut the fade
items.note: the same commit as the `stop(fadeMs)` fix.

items.claim: A non-finite rate or detune given straight to a voice kernel (`createNoiseKernel`, `retune`) was not checked
